title: PBMCs, pool BW1 (AMS1, AHC1)
extract_protocol_ch1: Cryopreserved PBMC samples were thawed and prepared as single-cell suspensions; viability exceeded 85% for all samples used for scRNA-seq profiling. Suspensions were combined into pools containing samples from up to three donors. Approximately 10,000 viable cells were targeted per sample, and each pool was loaded into one well of a Chromium Next GEM Single Cell 3' v3.1 chip (10x Genomics).
After GEM recovery, libraries were constructed according to the manufacturer's protocol (10x Genomics Chromium Next GEM Single Cell 3' Reagent Kit v3.1).
data_processing: FASTQ files were aligned to the GRCh38-2020-A reference transcriptome and processed into count matrices with Cell Ranger (v7.2.0 for the 12 W pools; v8.0.1 for the 16 BW pools).

BAM files from each multiplexed pool were demultiplexed to donors with Vireo using cellSNP allele counts and donor genotypes (gVCFs) from whole-genome sequencing; single-donor pools were assigned directly.
Assembly: GRCh38 (GRCh38-2020-A)

Supplementary files format and content: <pool>_barcodes.tsv.gz, <pool>_features.tsv.gz, <pool>_matrix.mtx.gz: Cell Ranger filtered_feature_bc_matrix output (Feature Barcode Matrix Exchange (MEX) format) for each pool, containing cell-level UMI counts.
